content.description:
At Weave, we’re building the operating system for small healthcare practices — powering communication, payments, and now AI-driven experiences for thousands of businesses and millions of patients.

Weave is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and operate reliable, high-performance mobile applications used by thousands of healthcare practices. This role combines hands-on Flutter and Dart development with native iOS expertise, mobile architecture, CI/CD, test infrastructure, release engineering, observability, and platform operations. You will own critical parts of the mobile lifecycle, from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident response.

The ideal candidate has strong technical judgment, understands mobile systems deeply, and can improve both the product and the engineering systems behind it. You will partner with Product, Design, Backend, Platform, Security, and Support teams while mentoring engineers and establishing scalable mobile engineering practices.

This is an opportunity to shape Weave’s mobile architecture, improve developer experience, and deliver reliable communication tools that healthcare practices depend on every day.

If you’re excited by meaningful ownership, technical influence, and building products that power real-world businesses — you’ll thrive at Weave.

- This role is remote within India

- This role reports to the Engineering Manager

What You Will Own

- Mobile Architecture: Design and evolve scalable Flutter/Dart applications with native iOS and Android integrations.

- CI/CD and Releases: Build and maintain GitHub Actions and Fastlane workflows for testing, signing, and App Store and Google Play deployments.

- Test Infrastructure: Define and improve unit, widget, integration, native UI, and end-to-end testing strategies.

- Mobile Operations: Own dependency updates, SDK upgrades, release health, crash monitoring, alerting, and incident follow-up.

- Performance and Reliability: Diagnose memory issues, UI jank, network latency, crashes, and background execution problems.

- Cross-Functional Delivery: Partner with Product, Design, Backend, Platform, Security, and Support teams to deliver reliable customer experiences.

- Platform Compliance: Lead annual iOS and Android SDK target version upgrades, manage OS deprecations, and maintain store policy compliance.

What You Will Need to Accomplish the Job

- 5+ years of professional mobile engineering experience

- Deep Flutter and Dart experience in production applications

- Strong native iOS experience with Swift and iOS SDKs

- Working knowledge of Android SDK, Kotlin, Gradle, and Android release processes

- Experience designing GitHub Actions and Fastlane pipelines

- Experience with mobile code signing, provisioning profiles, and store deployments

- Strong knowledge of unit, widget, bloc, integration, and end-to-end testing

- Solid understanding of WebSocket implementation for real-time communication, connection management, and error handling

- Strong knowledge of push notification services, including FCM and APNS

- Experience with Sentry, Crashlytics, Firebase Analytics, or similar tools

- Familiarity with dependency management, SDK upgrades, security updates, and compliance requirements

- Strong understanding of mobile architecture, state management, persistence, networking, and offline synchronization

- Strong knowledge of production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis using logs, metrics, traces, and crash reports

- Excellent communication, documentation, mentoring, and remote collaboration skills.

What will make us love you?

- You own the mobile lifecycle from architecture through production.

- You improve release safety, reliability, performance, and developer experience.

- You understand Flutter deeply, along with native iOS and Android.

- You use AI thoughtfully with strong engineering judgment and review standards.

- You mentor others and raise the mobile team's quality.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Beware of recruitment fraud. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.
